# Qurator by Quobby

> Qurator is a free, community-driven platform for creating and following interactive, step-by-step tutorials on any topic.

## What is Qurator?

Qurator lets anyone create interactive tutorials with a visual drag-and-drop flow editor. Tutorials support branching logic, comprehension quizzes, video, images, code blocks, and board game visualizations. Learners follow guided walkthroughs rather than reading static text.

## Key Features

- Visual Flow Editor: Build tutorials with drag-and-drop nodes, content steps, and branching logic
- Interactive Learning: Comprehension quizzes, checklists, and branching paths personalize each tutorial
- Community-Driven: Anyone can create, publish, rate, review, and fork tutorials
- Any Topic: Board games, cooking, DIY, software, music, sports, science, and more
- Smart Video: Upload videos up to 1 GB or paste YouTube/Vimeo links; split into segments
- Board Game Designer: Built-in hex grid, rectangular grid, and custom canvas board visualizer
- Embeddable: Every tutorial has an embed code for websites and blogs
- Free: Core experience costs nothing; Premium adds video splitting and analytics

## Tutorial Categories

- Board Games (how to play popular board games with interactive guides)
- Cooking & Recipes (step-by-step cooking tutorials)
- DIY & Crafts
- Software & Programming
- Music
- Sports
- Science

## Board Game Tutorials Available

Qurator hosts interactive how-to-play tutorials for popular board games including:
Catan, Wingspan, Terraforming Mars, Azul, Ticket to Ride, 7 Wonders, 7 Wonders Duel, Pandemic, Ark Nova, Sky Team, Codenames, Wyrmspan, Gaia Project, Earth, Cartographers, Heat: Pedal to the Metal, Marvel Champions, Sea Salt & Paper, Forest Shuffle, and many more.

Each board game tutorial includes setup instructions, rule explanations, strategy tips, interactive quizzes, and custom board visualizations.

## About Quobby

Quobby is a free mobile study companion app featuring flashcards with spaced repetition, document scanning, handwritten notes, habit tracking, a focus timer, and group study sessions. Qurator tutorials are integrated into the Quobby app.
